meaning.short_meaning: The pipal tree (Ficus religiosa); the sacred fig
meaning.long_meaning: Ashwath corresponds to the Sanskrit form अश्वत्थ. Its core lexical sense is the pipal tree (ficus religiosa); the sacred fig. अश्वत्थ (aśvattha) is the pipal tree (Ficus religiosa). The source gloss 'Horse, Vehicle of Gods' is a false etymology from अश्व (aśva, horse).
